resources.string: For analysis: reads all car parameters every 5 minutes and writes the changes to the Download folder. Up to 400 MB.
no access to the Download folder

Every 5 minutes (and when the mode changes: parked, driving, charging) the app reads all car parameters and writes only what changed to a file. The event recorder runs alongside. Read only: nothing in the car is changed. The fidscan-….txt files and the event recorder files are in the Download folder. No more than 400 MB is written in total, then recording stops by itself. If you switch the car off and on again, recording continues in a new file. To send them: turn the switch off and forward the files from Download to the developer.
